scope: Actual pinned restricted event placement, private delayed/suspended placement and list primitives; TCB canaries, FIFO event list, wraparound and native shared state
limitations: Critical entry/exit are bounded fixtures. The104-byte accessed TCB prefix preserves the native stack-depth word;112-byte construction is independently verified, and this test does not access its tail. No scheduler startup/context switching, physical concurrency or whole-image identity proof.
